card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A digit or space partway through a number, such as the thousands separator gap or the second digit of a decimal, fraction or larger figure. It fires before more digits follow.

modes.label: Gap or digit in thousands
modes.description: A space or digit inside a large number just before the final three zeros.

modes.label: Digit in decimals or fractions
modes.description: A digit after a decimal point or in a mixed fraction, with more digits to come.

modes.label: Digit in table or dose figures
modes.description: A middle digit of a number in a table or dose line.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a number, when more digits are still expected.
